title: Subscription cancellation manager
summary: Find and cancel subscriptions you've forgotten about.
whyTempting: Everyone wastes money on forgotten subscriptions.
whyItFails: One-time value. Once cleaned up, there's nothing left to do. Banks add it. Bank apps surface recurring payments. Cancellations are hard to automate. Merchants make cancelling deliberately difficult.
whatWouldChange: Click-to-cancel regulations and AI agents that can navigate cancellation flows.

attempts.notes: Tracked and cancelled subscriptions and negotiated bills; bought for $1.275 billion in cash, now Rocket Money.

reasons.detail: One-time value: Once cleaned up, there's nothing left to do.
Banks add it: Bank apps surface recurring payments.
Cancellations are hard to automate: Merchants make cancelling deliberately difficult.
